title: Home Recovery & A Thanksgiving of Victories
summary: Brought safely home to the walk-out basement sanctuary at 414 Geneva Street, Jordan navigates the painful early days of sternal precautions, sponge-bath protocols, and Daniel's strict one-partner bed rule, supported by Daniel and Laura's week off and recurring visits from Isabel, Henry Walsh, Garrett, and Kelsey. On Thanksgiving Day, after celebrating a heart-healthy feast with the entire family, Zoë's eldest sister Megan dumps her pushy boyfriend Alex at the front door when he tries to pressure her into moving in with him—setting the stage on Sunday night for a newly single Megan to move into Geneva Street as Jordan's daytime caregiver when classes resume.
